statements.quote: We continue to invest in capital expenditures as we scale our technical infrastructure, in particular for AI, to meet the demand of our users and enterprise customers and to support research internally.
statements.notes: Present tense and no year named. AI is given as a particular driver of capex in general, not as a quantified AI portion. The $91.4 billion 2025 capex (p07) and the 2026 'significantly increase' outlook (p02, p07) are not recorded because those sentences do not mention AI.

statements.quote: The costs associated with operating our technical infrastructure - depreciation, energy, equipment, and network capacity - are expected to significantly increase as developing and serving AI offerings require more compute power than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings.
statements.notes: Infrastructure operating costs are expected to rise, with AI compute named as the driver. No amount and no year are given.

statements.quote: (1)Alphabet-level activities primarily reflect expenses related to our shared AI research and development.
statements.notes: This is a table footnote: the Alphabet-level activities expense category is 'primarily' AI R&D. The passage has no amount, so it is qualitative. Confidence is lower because it describes the category rather than reporting spend directly.
